description.value:
Duration constant

Your own effective Strain limit is permanently 1 higher.

Your own body carries the weight of what it's become better than most. Your Strain (2 + your Constitution modifier, minimum 2) is permanently increased by 1 for the purpose of determining when you overflow into a weekly Bloom Table roll. This applies to your own mutations only, not a patient's.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, Strain has no rule-element representation to permanently raise.
